{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
# This step is now done to prevent future errors
if df['revenue'].dtype == 'object':
    df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
df = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Now, filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
filtered_df = df[
    (df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & 
    (df['channel'] == 'paid_search')
]

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of converted orders
n_total = len(filtered_df)
n_converted = filtered_df['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate = n_converted / n_total if n_total > 0 else 0

print(f"Total NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH: {n_total}")
print(f"Converted: {n_converted}")
print(f"Conversion rate: {conversion_rate}")"}
